claims.text:
stage computation: Fixed prefit linear weights[2,.1,.1,.1]. Four evaluation inputs are the coordinate basis, targets equal their original outputs. Keep only the largest-magnitude weight:75% sparsity, SSE=.03. An explicit alternative uniform-mask-family draw retains only coordinate2 (one-indexed), giving SSE4.02 at equal sparsity. Recompute all four predictions.

**Countercase / boundary:** Change evaluation to input[0,10,0,0], target1. Magnitude pruning predicts0, squared error1; the alternative mask predicts1, error0. This reverses the quality ordering. A single supplied mask is not an expected random-pruning result, and the fixture does not establish most weights of real networks are dispensable.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether equal75% sparsity implies equal output error; recall evaluation-input scaling can reverse which mask is preferable.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Toggle mask and Evaluation shift shows zeroed weight diagram, outputs and SSE with original comparison retained. Do not replace numerical evidence with a sparsity badge.
